detail.title: 2MP 25x Starlight IR WizSense Network PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SD5A225GB-HNR-SL 2MP 25x Starlight IR WizSense Network PTZ Camera Key Points • High-Quality Imaging with 2MP Resolution • 25× Optical Zoom Provide Close Up Views Over Expansive Areas • Expansive Night View With up to 150m IR Distance for 24/7 Monitoring • AcuPick Enables Fast and Precise Human&Vehicle Search • Auto Tracking 3.0：Effective Target Monitoring with Detailed Intruder Trajectories • IP67, IK10 and Anti-Corrosion Design for Reliable Protection Sales Enquiry Datasheet

General.Min. Illumination: Color: 0.005 lux@F1.6 B/W: 0.0005 lux@F1.6 0 lux (IR light on)
General.Pan/Tilt Range: Pan: 0° to 360° endless Tilt: –15° to +90°, auto flip 180°
General.IVS (Perimeter Protection): Tripwire; intrusion; climbing fences; loitering detection; abandoned/missing object; fast moving; parking detection; people gathering; vehicle/human alarm classification
General.Face Detection: Supports face detection, face bounding box, capturing snapshots, uploading face snapshots, enhancing face images, and selecting a preferred image among a group of snapshots. Attribute Extraction is also supported, where 6 attributes and 8 expressions can be detected. The attributes are gender, age, glasses, mask, mustache and expressions. The expressions are angry, sad, hate, scared, surprised, calm, happy and confused. Face cutout is also offered, where you can cutout one face at a time and customize the size to be a one-inch photo. The supported methods for capturing snapshots are real-time capturing, quality first, and selecting a preferred image among a group of snapshots.
General.Video Metadata: Detects motor and non-motor vehicles, faces and human bodies. It also performs tracking, takes snapshots, uploads high-quality face images and optimizes images. It extracts attributes from motor vehicles, detecting up to 10 attributes for them.
General.People Counting: Uses advanced image processing technology to extract depth information from images. The extracted information is then processed by advanced, deep learning algorithms to analyze and detect human bodies, and track targets in real time. The camera provides statistics for separate individuals' entrance and exit with up to 95% counting accuracy.
General.Auto Patrol: It triggers the IVS rule when a target is detected and makes the camera link with the PTZ to rotate to the position of the target and patrol based on its presets.
General.Acupick: Uses deep learning algorithms and works with back-end devices to accurately match targets, such as people and motor vehicles, and search through live and recorded videos to quickly locate targets.
General.Video Compression: Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264; H.264B; H.264H; MJPEG (Sub Stream 1)
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 1080p/1.3M/720p (1–50/60 fps)Sub stream 1: D1/VGA/CIF (1–25/30 fps)Sub stream 2: 1080p/1.3M/720p (1–25/30 fps)
General.Video Bit Rate: H264: 64 Kbps–10946 Kbps H265: 25 Kbps–6400 Kbps
General.White Balance: Auto; indoor; outdoor; ATW; manual; sodium lamp; natural light; street lamp
General.Privacy Masking: Up to 24 areas can be set, with up to 8 areas in the same view.
General.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; IPv4; RTSP; UDP; SMTP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; DDNS; IPv6; 802.1x; QoS; FTP; UPnP; ICMP; SNMP; SNMP v1/v2c/v3 (MIB-2); IGMP; ARP; RTCP; RTP; PPPoE; RTMP; TCP
General.Storage: FTP; Micro SD card (512 GB); NAS
General.Browser: IE 7 and later versions Chrome 42 and earlier versions Firefox 52 and earlier versions Safari
General.Management Software: Smart PSS; DSS; DMSS; Easy4ip; IVSS
General.Alarm Linkage: Capture; preset; tour; pattern; recording; triggering on-off value output; audio; sending email
General.Alarm Event: Motion/tampering detection; audio detection; network disconnection detection; IP conflict detection; memory card state detection; memory space detection; power exception detection
General.Power Consumption: Basic: 13 W Max: 22 W (illuminator + PTZ working + Heater + Fan)
General.Protection: IP67; IK10; TVS 6000 V lightning proof; surge protection; voltage transient protection
